description: This file contains test functions for the ChatService, specifically testing patient and medical agent behaviors, message handling flow, triage completion, and medication recommendations in a medical support chatbot system.

classes.name: ChatService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing chat sessions, handling messages, and generating recommendations within the medical chatbot system.

methods.name: test_patient_agent_does_not_repeat_questions_and_marks_triage_complete()
methods.description: Test to ensure the patient agent tracks asked and answered questions, avoids repetition, and correctly marks the triage process as complete when slots are filled.

methods.name: test_medical_agent_meds_gated_until_triage_complete()
methods.description: Test to verify that medication suggestions are withheld until the triage process is marked as complete.
